**Life expectancy at birth (years) – Top 5 largest countries by land area**

| Rank | Country | Life expectancy at birth | Year of estimate | Source |
|------|---------|--------------------------|------------------|--------|
| 1 | Russia | **73.7** | 2022 | World Bank – [SP.DYN.LE00.IN](https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.IN?locations=RU) |
| 2 | Canada | **82.4** | 2022 | World Bank – [SP.DYN.LE00.IN](https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.IN?locations=CA) |
| 3 | China | **76.1** | 2022 | World Bank – [SP.DYN.LE00.IN](https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.IN?locations=CN) |
| 4 | United States | **78.6** | 2022 | World Bank – [SP.DYN.LE00.IN](https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.IN?locations=US) |
| 5 | Brazil | **75.7** | 2022 | World Bank – [SP.DYN.LE00.IN](https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.IN?locations=BR) |

### Quick take‑away

| Country | Life expectancy |
|---------|-----------------|
| Canada | 82.4 yrs |
| Russia | 73.7 yrs |
| China | 76.1 yrs |
| United States | 78.6 yrs |
| Brazil | 75.7 yrs |

> **Why these values?**  
> The World Bank’s World Development Indicators (WDI) database provides the most recent, country‑specific life‑expectancy data that is widely used by researchers, policy makers, and international organisations.  The figures above are the latest complete years (2022) available for each of the five largest countries by land area.  

If you want the most up‑to‑date estimates for 2023 or beyond, the World Health Organization’s Global Health Observatory (GHO) publishes annual updates, though many countries still report 2022 as the latest finalised year.  You can view those datasets directly on the WHO site: https://www.who.int/data/gho/indicator-metadata-registry/imr.
